findings.evidence: What is the best estimate of the energy transferred to the battery during the time of 2.0 hours shown in the graph?
findings.suggested: Move this energy-transfer question to the relevant electricity chapter.
findings.resolution: keep: This is valid cross-topic electricity practice, not off syllabus: the source bank tags both 9702-9.1.3 and 9702-9.2.2. The area under the current-time graph applies charge = current × time: Q = 0.50 × 3600 + (0.50 × 3600)/2 = 2700 C. Using E = VQ gives 13500 J, approximately 14000 J, confirming official key C. Retain the item in this chapter because calculating charge is an essential assessed step.
